description: Create comprehensive integration test file tests/test_pr358_chat_audit.py that audits the chat pipeline for PR 358: English mode, Assamese mode, RAG fallback, response speed, and lang field override behavior.
steps: Create apps/backend/tests/test_pr358_chat_audit.py with the following test classes/functions:
CLASS: TestEnglishModeChatStream - Tests English mode chat end-to-end:

- test_english_stream_returns_correct_sse_format: POST /api/v1/chat/stream with {message: 'What is photosynthesis?', lang: 'en'}. Mock stream_response to yield chunks. Verify SSE events contain {content: ..., done: false} lines followed by final {done: true, lang: 'en', model: contains 'gemini'}.
- test_english_stream_routes_to_vertex: Verify that when lang='en', the route goes through vertex_client (mock stream_response, check it was called with gemini model).
- test_english_system_prompt_enforces_english: Call ChatService.build_system_prompt('en', []) and verify 'You MUST respond in English only' is present.
CLASS: TestAssameseModeChatStream - Tests Assamese mode chat end-to-end:

- test_assamese_stream_routes_to_sarvam: POST /api/v1/chat/stream with {message: 'পোহৰ সংশ্লেষণ কি?', lang: 'as'}. Mock stream_response to yield Assamese chunks. Verify SSE events contain Assamese text and final event shows lang='as'.

- test_assamese_fallback_to_vertex_on_sarvam_failure: Mock stream_response to raise RuntimeError for Sarvam, then mock vertex_client.stream_generate_with_retry to yield chunks. Verify the stream completes with a fallback event {fallback: true, provider: 'vertex'} and then content events.

- test_assamese_system_prompt_uses_assamese_script: Call ChatService.build_system_prompt('as', []) and verify 'You MUST respond in English only' is NOT present and Assamese script characters are present.
CLASS: TestRAGUnavailableFallback - Tests graceful degradation when RAG is unavailable:

- test_chat_responds_when_search_service_unavailable: Mock search_service.is_available() to return False. POST /api/v1/chat/stream with a real question. Verify the stream still completes with content (LLM base knowledge) and no error events.
- test_chat_responds_when_search_returns_empty: Mock search_service.is_available() to True but search_context returns []. Verify stream completes normally with content from LLM.
- test_chat_responds_when_search_raises_exception: Mock search_service.search_context to raise Exception. Verify stream still completes (retrieve_context catches exceptions and returns []).
- test_system_prompt_without_rag_context: Call ChatService.build_system_prompt('en', []) - verify it has a reasonable prompt without citation instructions.
CLASS: TestChatResponseSpeed - Latency/speed tests:
- test_stream_first_chunk_latency: With all services mocked (instant return), measure time from POST to receiving first SSE data line. Assert < 200ms.
- test_stream_total_completion_time: With all services mocked, measure time from POST to receiving final done=true event. Assert < 500ms.
- test_non_streaming_response_latency: POST /api/v1/chat/ (non-stream) with mocked services. Assert latency_ms in response < 500.
CLASS: TestLangFieldOverride - Tests the PR 358 fix (lang field correctly overrides auto-detection):
- test_lang_en_overrides_assamese_text: Send Assamese text but with lang='en'. Verify the route uses Vertex/gemini (not Sarvam).
- test_lang_as_overrides_english_text: Send English text but with lang='as'. Verify the route uses Sarvam model.
- test_lang_null_falls_back_to_detection: Send English text with lang=null. Verify auto-detection picks English and routes to Vertex.
- test_invalid_lang_rejected: Send lang='fr' (invalid). Verify 422 validation error.
Mocking strategy:

- Use unittest.mock.patch to mock: app.api.deps.rate_limit.check_rate_limit (return (True, 1, 100, 'monthly')), app.db.redis.get_redis (mock Redis), app.services.ai.router.stream_response (async generator yielding chunks), app.services.ai.router.generate_response (return string), app.services.search.vertex_search.search_service (mock is_available and search_context), app.services.chat_service.ChatService.check_topic_match (return topic match dict or None), app.utils.tracking.track_chat_completed (AsyncMock noop), app.api.v1.auth.get_current_user_optional (return None for anonymous)
- For stream tests, use httpx AsyncClient with ASGITransport following the pattern in conftest.py
- For speed tests, use time.time() around the request and assert on elapsed time
acceptance_criteria: All tests in test_pr358_chat_audit.py pass when run with: python -m pytest tests/test_pr358_chat_audit.py -v
English mode tests verify SSE format with content field and done event with lang='en'
Assamese mode tests verify Sarvam routing and Vertex fallback on Sarvam failure
RAG fallback tests verify the chat still responds (no error) when search_service is unavailable/empty/erroring
Speed tests verify < 500ms total latency with mocked services
Lang override tests verify the lang field correctly routes regardless of text content
No test relies on real external services (all AI/search/Redis/MongoDB mocked)
verification: cd apps/backend && eval "$(pyenv init -)" && pyenv shell 3.11.15 && python -m pytest tests/test_pr358_chat_audit.py -v --tb=short
findings: All 17 tests pass in 1.09s. The async generator fallback test required using 'raise RuntimeError' before a 'yield' statement (unreachable but needed for Python to recognize the function as an async generator). The test file uses a shared _common_patches() helper to reduce repetition across the 5 test classes.
